## Change

Describe the problem, what changed, and the resulting player or contributor experience.

## Related issue

Link an issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For code changes, run `npm run verify`. Include relevant multiplayer, collision, reconnect, or mobile checks for gameplay changes. Explain anything not tested.

For documentation-only changes, check links, examples, and formatting; a game build is unnecessary unless build inputs changed.

## Visual evidence

For interface changes, attach relevant desktop/mobile screenshots. Remove private information and credentials. Touch emulation alone does not establish physical-phone performance.
